description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per failed-call outcome - the payment buys one signed failure translation: the outcome artefacts you submit (re-issued 402, facilitator error body, HTTP status/headers, the original payload's nonce) are mapped under failure-translation/v1 to a reason class and a retry verdict (RETRY / DO-NOT-RETRY / RECONCILE-FIRST), with the raw reason printed verbatim. No composite score. Submitted artefacts are processed in memory only and are never stored.

outcome.description: The outcome artefacts of one failed paid call: {http_status?, settle_attempted?, facilitator_error?, response_headers?, reissued_challenge?, original_payload?} in the published submission form. Processed in memory only, never stored.

name: failure_translator_translate
